#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Add testcase `test_host_vlan_no_flooding` to verify that icmp packet destinated to the Vlan host interface is not flooding in the host VLAN bridge.

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <lolv@microsoft.com>


#### How did you do it?
1. set Vlan interface mac via config db
2. send icmp packets to the Vlan interface from one of the vlan member port
3. verify the icmp packet is not received from other vlan member host ports
